description: This file defines the 'Gridlines' class within the 'MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes.Charts' namespace. The class represents the gridlines on chart axes, providing methods for cloning, deep copying, serialization, and accessing line formatting properties. It is part of a larger library for document and chart rendering.
